apk.notes: Settings → Delete My Account. A shop's only owner can save a copy of its inventory and transactions first (install this version of the app for that).

web.notes: Settings → Label Printer can turn off printing labels after Complete Transaction. Con/Grade/Sealed boxes have a list (NM, LP, MP, HP, DMG, Sealed). Phone: Reprint Label on an item; Settings reordered. Settings titles capitalized.
